description: Had cholesterol check within past 5 years
epidemiological_interpretation: The elevated adjusted odds ratio (AOR ~ 3.44) for CholCheck reflects healthcare engagement and diagnostic detection opportunity rather than a causal or biological etiology. In cross-sectional survey surveillance (BRFSS), asymptomatic metabolic disorders like diabetes are predominantly identified during clinical encounters where routine metabolic screening (such as lipid panels) is co-administered. Individuals who have not undergone cholesterol screening have substantially lower opportunities for diabetes detection.
